title: The Vehicle Bay
summary: The Vehicle Bay builds combat units while powered. Select it to queue them.
text:
Turrets stay where you put them. **Combat units** go where the fight is. Build a **Vehicle Bay**, select it and tap a unit to queue it: alloys are paid when you queue, and **Cancel last** gives them back in full. The bay builds one at a time while it has power, and the finished unit rolls out of its door.

- The ⚔ readout counts your combat units. Tap it to select them all
- The colony can field twelve units to begin with (counting the queue); research raises that
- An Engineer working at the bay makes it build faster
- Idle units guard where they stand: they chase anything that comes close, or attacks a building nearby, then come back

The Shipyard builds boats and hover craft, and the Airpad builds flyers.
